gates.name: framing_reproduction
gates.description: report-only reproduction of the caption framing numbers from the emitted data

caption_numbers.point_ii: y derived from (avg_Q2, avg_x) differs from the quoted avg_y (excess of the quoted over the derived value) by +8 to +10% typically in the narrow S0-S2 cells (per-stratum medians; individual bins to +22.4%), by up to +63% in populated S3 bins and by up to +96% in the worst affected sparse S3 corner (data_n=16); W shifted by up to +42% [measured hierarchy; supervisor honesty fix 2026-10-16]
caption_numbers.point_iii: level_borndelta states the Born-vs-RAW sensitivity, up to ~+/-10% of avg_Q2 in S3 [critic verdict, mandated framing]

details.reproduction_definition: y_derived = avg_Q2/(avg_x * s), s = 4*27.6*920 GeV^2; W_derived = sqrt(m_p^2 + s*y_derived - avg_Q2)
details.note: the caption states the MEASURED hierarchy under this definition (2026-10-16 supervisor honesty fix): typical S0-S2 excess +8 to +10% (per-stratum medians; individual bins to +22.4%), populated S3 bins (data_n >= 40) to +62.8%, and +95.9% at the worst affected sparse S3 corner (data_n=16). The formerly quoted '+52%' figure understated both the populated-S3 maximum (five S3 bins with data_n >= 40 exceed +52%) and the sparse-corner worst case, and the instructed '+6 to +7%' typical is contradicted by the measured per-stratum medians (+8.4/+9.0/+10.0%); the caption therefore quotes the measured values. The worst-affected corner is sparse but not the absolute sparsest positive-data S3 bin (minimum data_n=2, excess +24.8%). All worst bins are in S3 (broadest x cell, 0.021 < x < 1.5 bookkeeping / x < 1.0 physical).

units.sigma_born_nb: nb (per-bin integrated Born-level cross section; NOT a density)
units.sigma_born_total_unc_nb: nb (total_with_cone15_rel x sigma_born_nb; includes the statistical component)
units.level_borndelta_v: same unit as avg_v (signed position delta, NOT an uncertainty to be combined)

nan_empty_policy: All consumed columns are gated finite before emission (gate finiteness_and_ranges); a non-finite consumed cell would abort the run with no outputs. No NaN or empty cell is emitted in either product. Structural zeros are explicit: sigma_stat is exactly 0 on no-tilt bins (70 entries, all variable x in the single-slot S3 cell; the untilted average is invariant to the data spectrum), and three bins (pos 109, pos 179, neg 240) have data_n = 0 -- their positions remain defined from the tilted MC population (their data-reco diagnostic columns in the source averages file are NaN by construction and are not consumed here).
